messages:
mara: Heads-up — onboarding sample app: REST route create works but JS SDK returns 422. Error says missing required field. Anyone seen SDK vs REST param drift?

aj: Likely naming mismatch or SDK stripping extra keys. Paste snippets?

mara: REST (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"name":"acct","model":"gpt-open-3","model_variant":"v2","timeout":30}'
```
SDK (422):
```js
// @redwood/sdk v1.4.2
client.routes.create({ name: 'acct', model: 'gpt-open-3', timeout_ms: 30000 })
// no model_variant in autocomplete, extra fields get dropped
```

aj: Confirmed: SDK uses timeout_ms and strips unknowns; backend expects timeout (s) and model_variant. That would trigger validation 422.

sam: Also noticed our higher-level wrapper has autoRetry enabled by default. For POST this caused a duplicate route when infra returned 500 and the client retried. Customer saw two routes created.

leo: Short-term mitigation: set an Idempotency-Key and disable autoRetry for creates:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ autoRetry: false, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': uuid() } })
await client.routes.create(payload)
```

devex-bot: Ticket DEVEX-4823 created: "js-sdk: align create-route payload with REST (expose model_variant, accept timeout or timeout_ms), and change retry defaults for non-idempotent methods" — https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-4823 :robot_face:

aj: I'll take SDK changes: add model_variant, accept both timeout and timeout_ms (normalize), and make autoRetry true only for idempotent ops.

mara: I'll attach a minimal repro and exact sdk version to the ticket and add an integration test comparing REST vs SDK payloads. Leaving updates in DEVEX-4823. :thumbsup:
